title: Some transformersexport / compiletests fails (Aborted (core dumped)) withtorch 2.9 nightlybut pass withtorch 2.8
bug_description:
# 🐛 Describe the bug

## To Reproduce

Running on A10

### 1. Install torch 2.9 nightly build:
> python3 -m pip uninstall -y torch torchvision torchaudio && python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir -U --pre torch torchvision torchaudio torchcodec --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cu126

- the report is based on `PyTorch version: 2.9.0.dev20250826+cu126`)
- without `torchcodec`, still hapeens
- test pass with torch 2.8

### 2. Install transformers

> git clone https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.git && cd transformers && git fetch origin && git checkout 242bb2cafccec9f90479f5f688bca9d240b1031f && pip install -e .[torch,testing]

### 3. Running test

> RUN_SLOW=1 python3 -m pytest -v tests/models/gemma/test_modeling_gemma.py::GemmaIntegrationTest::test_export_static_cache

> RUN_SLOW=1 python3 -m pytest -v tests/models/deepseek_v2/test_modeling_deepseek_v2.py::DeepseekV2ModelTest::test_sdpa_can_compile_dynamic

> RUN_SLOW=1 python3 -m pytest -v tests/pipelines/test_pipelines_document_question_answering.py::DocumentQuestionAnsweringPipelineTests::test_small_model_pt
